scope: Bounded primary-document search across Stata, SAS/STAT, Mplus, IBM SPSS, JMP and MATLAB; native longitudinal causal versus survival-regression capabilities separated.
search_method: Seed from prior commercial survey families, follow public official method documentation for treatment-effect survival, competing risks, time-dependent covariates and censoring.
stopping_rule: Eight fixed official endpoints; at most one official-path repair per failed candidate. Technical content, edition and rights must be inspected; empty/dynamic/denied responses become omissions.
historical_limit: Later public acquisition does not establish exact bytes available at the client cutoff; dated editions are recorded and later edition content receives no cutoff credit.
prior_search_failure: Old OpenAlex query concatenated every commercial/method keyword and returned zero candidates; this is a search failure, not software absence.
